verdict.rationale: Freshsales documents a REST API with a 'Create a Lead /api/leads' endpoint and per-user API keys, so an agent could create the lead record programmatically. The evidence does not show API support for filling company data or setting an owner; it only says owner data can be fetched by identifier. There is no MCP server, and the llms.txt, markdown-docs and OpenAPI probes all returned 404. missing for 10: documented company-data enrichment via API, documented owner assignment on create or update, an official MCP server, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent flow.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent enrich a new lead end-to-end via the API or MCP server — creating the record, filling company data, and assigning an owner

citations.quote: Each user in Freshsales is provided with a unique API key.
If you want data from your account, be it a deal or the owner of an account, you’d need its respective identifier to fetch the data via the API’s.
